Container.Name: m4b-audiobook-converter
Container.Overview: Watches a folder for multi-file MP3 audiobooks and automatically converts them into single chapterized M4B files using m4b-tool.
Container.Description:
Automatically converts multi-file MP3 audiobooks into single chapterized M4B files.
Key Features: - Watches input folder for new audiobook directories - Merges multiple audio files (MP3, M4A, OGG, FLAC, etc.) into a single M4B - Generates chapter markers from filenames - Auto-detects source bitrate for quality matching - High-quality AAC encoding via libfdk_aac - Failed conversions preserved with error logs (never deletes source on failure) - Optional backup of original files - Docker-native logging with rotation - Built on m4b-tool 0.5.2 with FFmpeg
Usage: 1. Drop audiobook folders (containing MP3s) into the Input directory 2. Container scans every 5 minutes (configurable) 3. Converted M4B files appear in the Output directory 4. Check /config/logs/ for per-book conversion logs

Config.Name: Input Directory
Config.Description: Directory to watch for new audiobook folders containing MP3/audio files

Config.Name: Output Directory
Config.Description: Directory where converted M4B files are placed

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Directory for logs and configuration state

Config.Name: Scan Interval
Config.Description: How often to scan for new audiobooks (e.g., 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h)

Config.Name: CPU Cores
Config.Description: Number of CPU cores for encoding (0=auto-detect all available)

Config.Name: Audio Bitrate
Config.Description: Output bitrate (auto=match source, or specify e.g., 128k, 192k, 256k)

Config.Name: Audio Codec
Config.Description: AAC encoder to use (libfdk_aac recommended for quality)

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99=nobody, standard for Unraid)

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100=users, standard for Unraid)
